distance_evaluations.meaning: One squared-L2 calculation for each first-discovered vertex, including entry; at most n.

expansions.meaning: Pending vertices popped to inspect all stored outgoing arcs; at most n.

neighbor_attempts.meaning: Stored outgoing arcs examined, including duplicates and self-loops.

already_seen_attempts.meaning: Neighbor attempts whose ID was already discovered; NOT duplicate expansions or proven useless work.

frontier_insertions.meaning: First-discovered candidates admitted to the bounded best/pending frontier, including entry; later eviction does not negate insertion.

invariants: ON and OFF output IDs and squared distances agree for the same inputs
